description: NaYTiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.98 Å. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.72 Å. Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.51 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five equivalent Na and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Y and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Y, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Y₂Ti₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OY₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent OY₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent ONa₂Y₂Ti₂ octahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Y and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted OY₂Ti₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Y₂Ti₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₂Y₂Ti₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OY₂Ti₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-77°.
